LanguageData.GR_TokraOrganicOperation_FloatMenuTransm: Recover and transmit Tok'ra observation data
LanguageData.GR_TokraOrganicOperation_OperatorIncapab: The operator must be capable of Intellectual work
LanguageData.GR_TokraOrganicOperation_OfferLetterText:
A cautious Tok'ra contact has opened a narrow channel. The cell has identified a peripheral position from which a compact field sensor could quietly record unusual Goa'uld movement near the colony.
Accepting the request will authorize delivery of the device and reveal the observation point. An Intellectual-capable colonist must carry the device to that position, leave it there while it records, then recover it and return it to the powered Tok'ra secure communicator. The offer remains available for about {0} hours. Ignoring it carries no trust penalty.

LanguageData.GR_TokraObservation_TargetLetterText:
A compact Tok'ra field sensor has been delivered through the usual discreet route. The cell has also marked a peripheral position from which it can record nearby Goa'uld traffic.
Select an Intellectual-capable colonist, right-click the delivered device and install it at the marked point. The same colonist will remain at the scope for roughly one to two hours, then pack it up, return it to the Tok'ra communicator and transmit the data as one continuous task. If the task is interrupted, right-click the installed site to continue. The operational window remains open for about {0} hours.

LanguageData.GR_TokraObservation_SuccessText1: {0} packed up the field sensor, returned it to the secure communicator and transmitted a record of irregular Jaffa patrol passages along a nearby route. The Tok'ra cell can now avoid the exposed intervals. {0} gains {1} Intellectual XP.

LanguageData.GR_TokraObservation_SuccessText3: {0} delivered a clean observation record showing changes in a Goa'uld supply corridor. The Tok'ra cell confirms that the route can be exploited without exposing the colony. {0} gains {1} Intellectual XP.

LanguageData.GR_TokraOrganicOperation_DeadDropOfferLe:
A Tok'ra cell wants to entrust the colony with a sealed module containing encrypted Goa'uld intelligence. Accepting authorizes delivery to the Tok'ra delivery zone, near a powered communicator if no zone is available, or to a reachable map edge as a last resort.
Select a colonist, then right-click the powered Tok'ra secure communicator to accept. The offer remains available for about {0} hours. Once delivered, an Intellectual-capable colonist must connect the module to that communicator and choose a decoding method. Ignoring the offer carries no trust penalty.

Within about {0} hours, select an Intellectual-capable colonist and use the powered Tok'ra secure communicator to begin analysis. The module contains no recoverable supplies and cannot be analyzed directly.

LanguageData.GR_TokraOrganicOperation_DeadDropLostLet: The request was accepted, but the Tok'ra intelligence module was lost or destroyed before its data could be decoded. The cell will be more cautious about relying on the colony.

LanguageData.GR_TokraOrganicOperation_IntelligenceDia:
{0} can connect the delivered module to the secure communicator.
Cautious analysis takes longer but keeps the transmission tightly contained. Accelerated decoding is faster and grants more Intellectual experience, but may create detectable interference capable of drawing a nearby Goa'uld patrol toward the colony. Once selected, the method remains fixed for this operation.
